note: Manual decisions for fetch-apple-links.mjs. skip: release ids that must get no link (Apple's High Voltage is the 1976 international version, not the Australian one). url: explicit album URLs (Hawkwind's original title is 'X in Search of Space'; Apple's Turbo 30 is the standard-priced reissue that includes the album). pick: Apple collectionId to prefer (the Iggy mix of Raw Power matches the 1973 original). Misfits Earth A.D.: Apple's 'Earth A.D. / Die, Die My Darling' is the CD reissue of the same album with the single added (confirmed by the site owner). Misfits Evilive: Apple's 'Evilive (Live)' is the later expanded edition of the 1982 live EP (confirmed by the site owner). Death Leprosy: the standard 2014 reissue has no streamable tracks; the deluxe reissue plays (reported by the site owner).
